set.body:
Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 7.4, 9, 10 landing 8. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M1C2TV1SJECKEQ6SNVSRBTHQ.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Owner: StoryAtlas consumer adoption; scientific producer remains StoryModel. External entry is the existing compiled-film G4/D1A-film/D1B route in storymodel4s/docs/refactor/PLAN.md, including bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P as a provenance reference. Foundation/signature closure is not a compiled-film receipt. No foreign dependency edge.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Remain blocked until exact reachable producer revision, canonical packet/codecs, admitted compiled-film source, occurrence/media bindings, synthetic generator and independent expected answers are supplied; then record entry and open this local gate.
2. Qualify source edition/asset identity, exact axes/transforms/support and distinctions among movie/subtitles/transcripts/annotations/model descriptions; no annotation point-time invention.
3. Consumer courts reject wrong edition/media/digests and preserve coarse/repeated/discontiguous support plus missing-media disposition. Record actual exact dependency pair and existing-consumer regression evidence.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep source/text/annotation preview labeled; never substitute it for final compiled-film admission.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Film] Adopt exact compiled-film, occurrence and media capabilities
